subject: gk
question: What is the title of the autobiography written by the renowned American professional boxer, Mike Tyson?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Undisputed Truth: My Autobiography**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mike Tyson**__ is considered to be one of the greatest heavyweight boxers of all time.
 
• The Autobiography of Mike Tyson is Undisputed Truth: My autobiography.
 
• A bare-knuckled, tell-all memoir from Mike Tyson, the onetime heavyweight champion of the world—and a legend both in and out of the ring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Greatest__: My Own Story is a 1975 autobiography of heavyweight boxer Muhammad Ali.
